specs.title: rules are opt-in, validate before installation, persist explicit entity state, and survive offline export and restore
manual freeform passages carry independent state copies and disabling or removing a rule preserves narrative and snapshots on mobile
invalid rule files do not change the world and a missing installed binding stays readable without executing
